toegepas.voor: kom net vir 'n oomblik op die grond af
toegepas.na: kom net vir 'n oomblik op die grond neer
toegepas.rede_vinder: Something that comes down onto the ground 'kom neer' in natural Afrikaans; 'kom op die grond af' is wooden.
toegepas.fout: 'kom op die grond af' is a loose, slightly wooden way of saying the mark lands on the ground
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Op die grond neerkom' is the natural fixed verb for something landing, echoes 'neergesit' two sentences earlier, and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.na: sodat die voertuig maklik kan ry
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Voordat' suggests an order in time; the sentence states what is needed for the vehicle to move easily, which 'sodat ... kan ry' expresses naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'voordat die voertuig maklik ry' reads as a time order copied from English 'before', where a condition for easy movement is meant
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Moet ... sodat die voertuig maklik kan ry' states the requirement naturally, keeps the necessity, and the next sentence still says what happens if the wheel does not turn.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Na onder kyk' means looking downwards; the sentence means looking underneath the box, which 'onder die boks' says plainly.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Kyk weer na onder' is natural Afrikaans for looking down at what happens beneath the box, and the proposal repeats 'boks' twice in one short sentence without being clearly better.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Terwyl dit onder is' is vague; the previous sentence already speaks of the wheel touching the ground, so this keeps the meaning and is clearer.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The proposal makes the sentence say the piece stays still on the ground while it touches the ground, a tautology; 'terwyl dit onder is' carries the wheel's position at the bottom of its turn.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Dan' reads as a time sequence; 'So' gives the intended result of the axle holding the wheel upright.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Dan' already reads naturally as 'in that case' after the axle holds the wheel upright; 'So' is a lateral swap of a linking particle.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Merk een plek op 'n wiel met kryt.
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Merk met kryt een plek op 'n wiel.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: As written, 'n wiel met kryt' can be read as a wheel that has chalk on it; moving the instrument forward removes the ambiguity.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original is the natural order and no reader takes 'n wiel met kryt' as a chalky wheel; the proposal is stiffer.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Wanneer 'n wiel en 'n as goed werk
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: wip op en af elke keer as die wiel omdraai
laat_vaar_vorige.na: wip elke keer op en af as die wiel omdraai
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Keeping 'elke keer' next to its 'as'-clause separates them less and reads more naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The original order already flows, and the proposal actually separates 'elke keer' from its 'as'-clause, the opposite of its stated reason.
